properties.description:
BUILT AND VERIFIED 2026-10-29 (commit 94ecdda9c: call_can_give_the_owners_word in service.rs, decision_landing_hint and replace_text in tools/capture.rs), increment 2. The pilot's commonest cue (set_decision_status, 101 offered, 5 followed) came from two replies: add_decision's "a Decision lands `proposed` — only the owner's word moves it (set_decision_status)" (25) and replace_text's "if the change is a settlement, set_decision_status carries the owner's word" (76). A solo agent recording someone else's project cannot give that word, so the cue named a call that was never its to make (fact:in-the-recall-pilot-agents-followed-4-percent-of-reflow2s-cues-within-five-calls-2026-10-29).

THE RULE, revised 2026-10-29 the same day (Anthony: "Go with your recommendation and fix them first"; fact:root-cause-the-settling-cue-read-an-unnamed-local-caller-as-not-the-owner-2026-10-29): the cue is offered UNLESS the caller is KNOWN and is not the owner. A known caller is the contributor the call is made for (the request's or session's writes_for; behind a trusted gateway or bearer gate, the caller the engine established); where the design names its owner (a Project OWNED_BY a Contributor) they must be one of them, and a design naming no owner takes a named caller at their word. A call naming nobody is the person running reflow2 on a LOCAL engine (stdio, --shared, loopback --http, --call), so it is offered the cue; on an engine served for others (crate::caller served_for_others) nobody unnamed can sign, so it is not. The first build (94ecdda9c) read "nobody named" as "not the owner", which told the owner working alone, and every --call, that settling was a question for the owner. Behind flo2.io's gateway every call is named, so the behaviour there is unchanged. Where the cue is not offered, both hints say what the cue is: a question for the owner, put to them with ask_question, not the agent's next call — and they no longer name set_decision_status, so it is not counted as offered. Additive: the field and its other wordings are unchanged.

Distinct from the counting capability: that one measures cues; this one changes who a cue is addressed to. A cue its reader cannot act on measures nothing but noise.
properties.name: A cue that asks for the owner's word is offered as the agent's next call unless the caller is known and is not the owner; a known non-owner is told it is a question for the owner
